canonical_title: Noncomplying agricultural and fire fighting airplanes.

versions.title_at_revision: Noncomplying agricultural and fire fighting airplanes.
versions.text:
[(a) This section applies to propeller-driven, small airplanes that--
  (1) Are designed for "agricultural aircraft operations" (as defined in Sec. 137.3 of this chapter, effective on January 1, 1966) or dispensing fire fighting materials; and
  (2) Have not been shown to comply with the noise levels prescribed under appendix F of this part--
    (i) For which application is made for the original issue of a standard airworthiness certificate and that do not have any flight time before January 1, 1980; or
    (ii) For which application is made for an acoustical change approval, for airplanes which have a standard airworthiness certificate after the change in the type design, and that do not have any flight time in the changed configuration before January 1, 1980.
(b) For airplanes covered by this section an operating limitation reading as follows must be furnished in the manner prescribed in Sec. 36.1581: Noise Abatement: This airplane has not been shown to comply with the noise limits in FAR Part 36 and must be operated in accordance with the noise operating limitation prescribed under FAR Sec. 91.56.]
